description: Einnahmenüberschussrechnung (EÜR)-style profit and loss for a month, quarter or year: net income by tax rule (Steuerregel), net expenses by booking account (Buchungskonto, number and name), the result, and VAT flows apart (Umsatzsteuer collected, Vorsteuer paid, VAT paid to or refunded by the Finanzamt). Fixed assets (Anlagegüter) are listed apart, without depreciation (AfA). basis: cash (default, Zufluss-/Abflussprinzip: payments sevDesk links to documents, by value date) or accrual (by document date). Positions are read one by one (up to 1,500 documents). Call it directly with the period: it reads the accounts and payments itself. Computed here from sevDesk data: not the Anlage EÜR (which works gross) and not a tax return.

basis.description: cash (by payment day, default) or accrual (by document date).

year.description: Calendar year; alone for the whole year, or with month or quarter.

name: sevdesk_profit_and_loss
title: Profit and loss (EÜR-style)
